data.title: 英梨梨 · 那须高原私家温泉的水汽微醺
data.description: 在泽村家那须高原的度假别墅内，私人露天风吕水汽蒸腾。英梨梨将标志性的长金发盘在脑后，浸泡在温热的泉水中。当听到屏风后传来的呼唤时，她整个人像熟透的红苹果般沉进水里只露出眼睛，水珠顺着白皙滑腻的肩头滑落，羞愤地娇叱对方不许转过身来。
data.action: soaking in onsen, hair up in bun, shoulders bare in water, deep crimson blush
data.lighting: steamy dusk light with pine trees silhouetted
data.promptProse: Soaking up to her shoulders in the steaming private hot spring of her family villa, Eriri Spencer Sawamura has her blonde hair pinned into a damp bun. Steaming water beads on her delicate collarbones as she glares with intense, adorably flustered embarrassment.
data.animaCaption: Eriri flustered in the steamy private hot spring with her hair up.
